Happy Birthday mera Buggu! 🎂💗

Mai hamesha chahunga ki tu khush rahe, maze karti rahe... Life get tough sometimes, but there is always a way to correct some things.

Maybe karne ka mann na kare, aisa lage ki akele hi theek hu, ab badalna nahi hai, kisiko apnaana nahi hai, sabse dur jaana hai... par aisa nahi hai Buggu. 🫂

Shyd meri baatein bachkaani lage, par kya pata aage kuch accha ho. Tu hi kehti hai na — try karte raho.

To shyd ek baar karke dekh. Log abhi bhi wahi hain, kahi nahi gaye, bas niraash hain. Aur jinse pyaar hota hai, unhe manaake wapas le aao, to vo aur dhyaan rakhte hain. 💗

The only valuable thing in everyone's life is their friends and maybe relationships... Unke saath hi aisa lagta hai ki aap, aap hain. You don't have to pretend.

I don't know what will be your reaction reading this, but I always wanted to be with you. I wish for you to come back.

You will never lose me and Anshika too. 🫂 I will be your bestest buddy and crime partner...
